title: Provide REDDHI maturity stages with measurable markers
requirements:
- Define maturity stages (e.g. foundational, intermediate, advanced) without making REDDHI a one-time certification
- Consider security, service performance, semantic maturity, workforce capacity and reuse within the progress framework
- Distinguish infrastructure maturity from how faithfully clinical reality is represented
- Make markers measurable (coverage, quality, use, resilience) rather than binary
- Include governance status and dependency integrity in component coverage
- Offer a self-assessment instrument or template and map it to established maturity frameworks
